beats: Ghost Interviewer runs on one shared API key, and the only thing standing between a stranger and that key was knowing the sign-in URL.
Any Google account could open a session and start spending real credits.
Now Google OAuth checks every sign-in against an explicit allow-list before it lets anyone in.
The same check runs again on the token exchange, and again on every request after that.
Tried a second personal account to break it — all three checks rejected it.
